name: pi-agent-server
description: A long-running Pi Agent service built with Fastify and the Pi SDK.

scripts.build: node scripts/dist-hygiene.mjs clean dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/dist-hygiene.mjs check dist && npm run build:drill
scripts.build:migrate: node scripts/dist-hygiene.mjs clean dist-migrate && tsc -p tsconfig.migrate.json && node scripts/smoke-migrate-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-migrate-package.mjs
scripts.build:backup: node scripts/dist-hygiene.mjs clean dist-backup && tsc -p tsconfig.backup.json && node scripts/smoke-backup-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-backup-package.mjs
scripts.build:file-ops: node scripts/dist-hygiene.mjs clean dist-file-ops && tsc -p tsconfig.file-ops.json && node scripts/smoke-file-ops-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-file-ops-package.mjs
scripts.build:reconcile-jsonl: node scripts/dist-hygiene.mjs clean dist-reconcile && tsc -p tsconfig.reconcile-jsonl.json && node scripts/smoke-reconcile-jsonl-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-reconcile-jsonl-package.mjs
scripts.build:owner-transfer: node scripts/dist-hygiene.mjs clean dist-owner-transfer && tsc -p tsconfig.owner-transfer.json && node scripts/smoke-owner-transfer-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-owner-transfer-package.mjs
scripts.build:drill: node scripts/dist-hygiene.mjs clean dist-drill && tsc -p tsconfig.drill.json && node scripts/smoke-drill-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-drill-package.mjs
scripts.test:restore-real: pnpm test:age && cross-env PI_RUN_REAL_AGE_RESTORE=1 vitest run tests/backup/restore-core.test.ts
scripts.test:owner-transfer: pnpm test:age && cross-env PI_RUN_REAL_AGE_OWNER_TRANSFER=1 vitest run tests/owner-transfer/owner-transfer-real-age.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:backup && npm run build:file-ops && npm run build:reconcile-jsonl && npm run build:owner-transfer && npm run build:drill
scripts.verify:release: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:postgres && npm run test:pg-backup && npm run test:migration-prebackup && npm run test:file-ops-pg && npm run test:reconcile-jsonl-pg && npm run test:restore-real && npm run test:owner-transfer && npm run test:owner-transfer-pg && npm run build && npm run build:migrate && npm run build:backup && npm run build:file-ops && npm run build:reconcile-jsonl && npm run build:owner-transfer
scripts.release:rc: npm run verify:release && npm publish --tag rc
